chapter_path_zh: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
content.stem: 一家金融机构(FI)的合规官正在审查一家虚拟资产服务提供商(VASP)的新客户申请.在确定客户是否属于金融机构的金融犯罪风险偏好范围时,风险评估应包含哪些细节？(选择三项.)

options.A: 虚拟资产服务提供商(VASP)的程序是否足以保护客户个人身份信息
options.B: 该虚拟资产服务提供商(VASP)的客户中有多少比例被归类为高风险客户？
options.C: 哪些注册机构代表虚拟资产服务提供商（VASP）运营虚拟资产钱包和虚拟资产兑换营业点
options.D: 该虚拟资产服务提供商(VASP)是否正在使用中央银行数字货币
options.E: 该虚拟资产服务提供商(VASP)的客户是谁,包括外国和国内个人客户的详细信息

content.stem_en: A compliance officer at a financial institution (FI) is reviewing a new client application for a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP). Which details should be part of the risk assessment to determine whether the customer falls within the FI's financial crimes risk appetite? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Whether the VASP's procedures are sufficient for protecting client personally identifiable information
options_en.B: What percentage of the VASP's clients are classified as higher-risk
options_en.C: Which registered institutions act on behalf of the VASP as operators of virtual asset wallets and virtual asset exchange offices
options_en.D: Whether the VASP is utilizing central bank digital currencies
options_en.E: Who the VASP's clients are, including the breakdown of foreign and domestic individuals
